info.description:
Telegraph is the on-chain signal layer for Bittensor.
This API provides access to AI inference subnets via x402 micropayments.

## Authentication
No API keys required. All endpoints use x402 (HTTP 402 Payment Required).
Pay $0.01 USDC per call on Base or Solana. The payment IS the authentication.

## x402 Flow
1. Make your request normally
2. Receive HTTP 402 with payment details (network, token, amount, address)
3. Submit on-chain USDC payment
4. Retry the request — receive your inference result

get.description: FRAUD_DETECTION. Assess how likely the specific entity, transaction, or action named in the required natural-language query is to be fraudulent. For an on-chain address, screen round-trip returns, transfer velocity, counterparty concentration, dust fan-in, and repeated identical amounts. For a transaction hash, screen its sender and return transaction context. Reviewed named cases receive a concise source-backed factual answer; unknown off-chain subjects are reported out_of_coverage rather than guessed. Returns a bounded risk_score, risk_tier, concise verdict, and measurements for on-chain subjects.
